author: etainproject on Sketchfab
note: ETAIN / Arno Thielens worker honeybee micro-CT surface, in native millimetres. Its approximately 11 mm body is preserved within the catalog’s representative 12.5 mm scale, rather than enlarged to fill it. The preserved compact pose and unresolved/absent wing and leg detail remain as in the scan; no flying pose, hair or missing appendages are invented. Amber false colour is for inspection, not measured pigmentation.

processing.source_model_name: Western Honeybee - Adult Worker - CT Scan
operations: Convert legacy specular-glossiness materials to supported metallic-roughness
Simplify toward 50k triangles; error tolerance 0.005; preserve relative geometry
Prune and quantize positions/normals/UVs; no compressed mesh decoder
